# Fixtures for rd_date_one_ab, rd_empty_skip_ab and rd_no_volume_break_ab and
# their OpenGL twins (port/render/test/rd_shadow_cuts_ab.cmake: one DATE set-up
# for the shadow composites, the empty composites skipped, a shadow window with
# no volume taken with SCENE's pass ended at the resolve; each off against on,
# byte for byte): fixture names of this repository
# (port/render/test/fixtures/NAME.rdfix), a name a line.  The word after a
# name: "volume" (one shadow window with volumes, the three composites) or
# "novolume" (one window without a volume, the three composites).  A third
# word: the passes fewer at the Mali setting with the empty composites on
# (three R8 passes and three SCENE passes of no draw: measured on the fixture,
# 38 against 32).
#
# a character's shadow at 21:9
fx-shadow-wide volume
# the opening's lamps view: a shadow window with no volume
fx-lamps-novolume novolume 6
# the opening's dark room and the sun
fx-opening-dark volume
fx-opening-sun volume
# the Mali-G52's F12 frame and a slow-scene capture
fx-mali-frame volume
fx-mali-slow541 volume
